data.body: Currentization at origin/main cbc02f0e591d4c6811bb1bfbd87885e62098198a: test_det_floor_module_seam.py is deleted, so its 2 docstrings and path are retired from this leaf. The surviving scope is 8 leading docstrings in 6 files. Description, file-impact, and all 5 DD commands now use the surviving paths; the executable AST oracle compares current-parent to final tree, while the older SHA remains historical audit provenance. This is still active comment-remediation work and is paired with the facades leaf in a grouped Gerrit change.
